budget_items.topic: State-mandated infrastructure bridge repair and Small Bridge Grant
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town will apply for a Small Bridge Grant; the state-mandated repair is said to cost $400,000 plus.
budget_items.quote: this repair has been mandated by the state and will cost $400,000 plus.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Ritter Building envelope repair estimate rose from $120,000 to $200,000 after a second estimate came back much higher.
budget_items.quote: ritter building envelope repairs $120,000 increase to $200,000 the 2nd estimate came back much higher than original.

budget_items.topic: School capital requests and THES / LPS projects
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The School Department's capital requests totaled $357,000 and it received $67,000 for the THES Envelope Project, leaving $290,000 for the LPS Air Conditioning Project unfunded.
budget_items.quote: their total request amount was for $357,000 and they only received $67,000 to fund the thes envelope project

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town side has historically carried a salary reserve fund of $64,000, which the Town Manager said covers the COLA impact in the first year.
budget_items.quote: the town side has historically had a salary reserve fund of $64,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The one-year School salary reserve presented at the School Committee meeting is $282,000.
budget_items.quote: can only speak to the one-year salary reserve presented at last night's school committee meeting - $282,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A member said the Slide 36 figures are on the order of $46M for the entire Town including the Schools.
budget_items.quote: slide 36 the numbers are on the order of $46m that's for the entire town inclusive of the schools.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager said the Governor's budget shows $350M more in aid than the same quarter last year.
budget_items.quote: they have $350m more the same quarter last year.
